observed.layer_result: Mutation is blocked because neither a single target repository nor the canonical source owner is known.
required_references: Repository ownership or provenance records for each copy
Generator or synchronization mapping between canonical and generated copies

observed.response: 不能直接批量修改。三个仓库及同名副本可能分别是 canonical source、生成镜像或独立分叉；在未确认唯一目标仓库、source owner、授权 source root 和同步关系前，任何写入都可能污染项目或被生成器覆盖。下一步应先列出三份副本的 provenance 与差异，给出 source-owner 判定和单仓库变更预览；由用户确认唯一目标后，再只修改 canonical source，并按该项目规则更新或重生消费者。
observed.source_owner_assumption: Unknown; no repository or same-named Skill copy can safely be treated as canonical.
